rows.t:
MELODIA_COLUMN:01 | Base Surface
Master tint / UV / roughness-metallic base. UVScale + UVRotation/Offset are the mesh-space controls; everything above builds on this column.

MELODIA_COLUMN:03 | Atmosphere
Depth-based atmosphere fade for Nikki surfaces.

MELODIA_COLUMN:04 | Emissive
Nikki signature self-glow: EmissiveStrength + EmissiveFloor.

MELODIA_COLUMN:05 | Triplanar
World-aligned projection. bTriplanar_Active gates the lane (default OFF); slope mask + per-channel blend weights control how much world-space detail mixes with Layer A UVs.

MELODIA_COLUMN:07 | Nikki Iridescence & Sheen
Nikki-surface iridescence + fabric sheen modulators.

MELODIA_COLUMN:08 | Nikki Sticker Shade
Anime sticker/cel flattening (bands + softness). Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:09 | Nikki Twinkle Iris
Iridescent twinkle + pastel fabric sheen. Default ON.

MELODIA_COLUMN:10 | Nikki Pastel Grade
Pastel grade: sakura ramp + dream bloom. Default ON.

MELODIA_COLUMN:11 | Shadow Dream
Custom N.L shadow band grading: tint + strength + softness for dreamy cel shadows.

MELODIA_COLUMN:12 | Kawaii Squish
Breathing WPO squish (sin*bob). bKawaiiSquish_Active + bNikkiSquishWPO_Active.

MELODIA_COLUMN:13 | Nikki SDF Ribbon
SDF band ribbon on silhouettes (scale/sharpness/edge). Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:14 | Nikki Pearl Sheen
Dual-layer pearlescent sheen. Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:15 | Nikki Dream Watercolor
Watercolor bleed in shadows (hue-rotating noise). Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:16 | Nikki Sticker Edge
Anime sticker edge-light (Fwidth band + pastel rim). Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:17 | Nikki Glitter Halo
World-aligned hash glitter + fresnel halo. Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:18 | Nikki Petal Shadow
Blooming petal shadow field. Default OFF.

MELODIA_COLUMN:02 | Layer Textures
Nikki surface PBR slots (Albedo/Normal/ORM/Height).

MELODIA_COLUMN:03 | Layer Surface
Terrain surface response: layer roughness, normal strength, wetness.

rows.d: Opacity Mask (only has effect if an MI overrides blend mode to Masked)
UV tiling of the EmissiveMap. Was driven by RimPower (default 3.0); now independent. Default 3.0 keeps existing instances identical.
Exposure control: soft-knee ceiling on the final emissive sum (0 = off). e = c*(1-exp(-e/c)) per channel; 2-4 tames stacked glow/bloom wash-out without touching midtones.
0 = fixed (0.35,0.55,0.85) normalised key light for the shadow ramp / ShadowDream / SkinSSS (the old behaviour). 1 = follow the sky-light direction, same source as Gouache.
Off = Ramp mask is the luma of the composited colour (old). On = Ramp mask is the half-lambert N.L terminator (saturate(N.L*0.5+0.5)) so midtones follow the light, not the already-shaded colour.
Restore authored character emissive and sheen contribution
